data.one_liner: Utility library for geographic calculations and polyline encoding/decoding.
data.what_it_does: Provides functions to compute distances, headings, destination points, and encode/decode polylines in the Google format. It also offers a simple LatLng type for coordinates.
use_when: You need basic geodesic calculations in a Dart/Flutter app.
You want to encode or decode polyline strings for mapping APIs.
You need a lightweight, dependency-free library for coordinate math.
avoid_when: You require advanced map rendering or integration with map widgets.
You need geofencing or location services beyond simple math.
strengths: Supports null safety and is lightweight.
Includes polyline codec for common mapping APIs.
weaknesses: No UI components or map rendering.
Limited to basic geographic math only.
